meta.producto: Small orange decorative items are being sorted and arranged into linear rows.
meta.operacion: The right hand picks individual orange parts from the central pile while the left hand organizes and pushes them into a structured linear row.
meta.lugar: Supply area: large pile of orange parts in the center. Work point: center-left where parts are aligned into rows. Other parts/bins are located at the top-left, top-right, and bottom-right.
meta.convencion_texto: holding the workpiece while the other hand is only transporting (not operating) is also D (course convention);
meta.camara: Operator is at the bottom. The left hand (Cyan) appears on the left/center and the right hand (Magenta) appears in the center/right of the image.
meta.title_en: Plastic parts assembly at a factory station (factory video, CC BY 4.0)
meta.motor_en: Gemma 4 31B on AMD GPUs (AMD Token Factory, shared endpoint)
meta.licencia_en: Video: Factory Manipulation Videos by Procedural Robotics Inc. (huggingface.co/datasets/procedural-robotics/factory-manipulation-videos), CC BY 4.0. Excerpt 60-210 s of plastic_assembly_station05_worker032.mp4, re-encoded; chart computed by Gilbreth.
